name: braintone
description: A short brain workout you can open with /braintone while Claude works. Esc closes it.

server_url.title: BrainTone server URL
server_url.description: The BrainTone server the Mod talks to over its /v1 API. http://localhost:8787 for a local braintone-server/.

invite.title: BrainTone invite
invite.description: The invite code from your install command. The Mod swaps it for its own token the first time you open /braintone. Leave empty for a local server without invites.
